calls.thesis: EV/EBITDA and P/FCF both below 8x on $7.5B market cap with ~$1B/yr buybacks (~15% of shares); 2030 MGM Japan (Osaka, ~$10B property) is the real catalyst - MBS proxy (~$6B rev, ~$3B adj. EBITDA) implies his 44% stake alone could be worth the whole market cap.
calls.bull: 'That property could be worth 10, 20 billion... even just the 44% stake MGM has could be worth their entire market cap today.'
calls.bear: Las Vegas Strip revenue slightly down past two years post 2022-23 surge; Japan 2030+ timeline needs capital spending before payoff.
calls.stated_price: No target; EV/EBITDA and P/FCF both below 8x, P/FCF ~5x
